overview.en:
Manage Descope identity projects, users, tenants, access controls and flows through its official MCP server.

Inspect identity configuration in the selected organization or project before proposing changes. Keep authentication flows and access-control scope explicit.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Descope 官方 MCP 管理身份认证项目、用户、租户、访问控制和认证流程。

提出修改前检查选定组织或项目的身份配置，明确认证流程与访问控制范围。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review this project's authentication configuration and explain its flow.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个项目的认证配置，并解释流程。

starterPrompts.en: Help diagnose this login or organization-access issue.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 协助排查这个登录或组织访问问题。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a configuration change for review before applying it.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备配置变更供审阅，先不要应用。

descriptions.en: Use Descope in Ghast. Manage Descope identity projects, users, tenants, access controls and flows through its official MCP server. 通过 Descope 官方 MCP 管理身份认证项目、用户、租户、访问控制和认证流程。
